spatial_20d.coordinates: Every node carries a TRUE coordinate x in R^20. Not a label, not a lattice vertex — an actual 20-vector.
spatial_20d.rotations: Real SO(20): 20x20 orthogonal matrices, det=+1. Interaction uses Givens rotations in coordinate planes. What the user spins is a genuine 20D rotation.
spatial_20d.sampling: Node placement in 20D via proper uniform sampling on S^19 (normalized Gaussian / Marsaglia). Mathematically honest distribution, not vibes.
spatial_20d.projection: Formal 20->3 projection: a real projection matrix P: R^20 -> R^3 with orthonormal rows (or stereographic from S^19). The ball the user sees IS the projected 20D structure.
spatial_20d.descent: Diving a doll deeper = rotating the view into higher coordinate planes (x4-x5, x6-x7, ...). 'Stranger with depth' is genuine higher-dimensional structure revealed — new 3D slices of the same true 20D object — never decoration.
spatial_20d.distance: Resonance/dimensional addressing by true Euclidean distance in R^20.
spatial_20d.no_confusion_law: The user manipulates a 3D projection + one depth control. The 20D math is the engine, not the wallpaper. Tap a node to see its true 20-coordinate.
spatial_20d.vr_killer: 20 real dimensions, navigable by double-click on a phone. No headset, no controllers.

real_machinery.so20: R^T R = I, det = +1. 190 skew-symmetric generators. R = exp(A). Angular velocity tensor Omega = Rdot R^T.
real_machinery.interpolation: Geodesic interpolation R(t) = R0 exp(t log(R0^T R1)). No Euler/Tait-Bryan angles — they do not generalize to 20D.
real_machinery.sampling: Uniform S^19: z ~ N(0, I_20), z / ||z||. Haar-uniform SO(20): QR of Gaussian matrix.
real_machinery.projection: Orthogonal P = Q Q^T (P^2 = P, P^T = P), y = Q^T x. Johnson-Lindenstrauss random projections when distance preservation matters.
real_machinery.source: Classical mechanics (Lie groups), quantum linear-algebra toolkit, statistical mechanics (sampling), relativity (invariant-first design). Per 2026-10-14 physics research.

interaction_algebra.law: Nodes are lattice vectors; interactions come from inner products and the cocycle — real algebra, not decoration.
interaction_algebra.lattice_voa: For an even lattice L, V_L = direct sum of Heisenberg Fock modules; multiplication via intertwining operators with sign cocycle e_a e_b = (-1)^{(a,b)} e_b e_a. Rank-20 even lattice => c = 20. The lattice orthogonal group embeds in Aut(V_L).
interaction_algebra.note: c is not a free spatial-dimension counter — the c=20 match is suggestive, not an identity. Design decision: which rank-20 even lattice is still open.
honest_limits: No native SO(20) action on the VOA interaction parameter — rotations and fusion live in different formalisms; the bridge is designed, not given.
interaction_algebra.source: 2026-10-14 VOA research (Wikipedia: Vertex operator algebra; Frenkel-Kac-Segal construction).

calculus.flux: n-dimensional divergence theorem: flux conservation licensed in R^20. Generalized Stokes: integral over boundary of omega = integral over domain of d(omega) — the fundamental theorem of multivariate calculus.
honest_limits: curl is R^3-native: the 20D engine must use differential forms, not vector-curl. SO(20) as a group (Lie algebra, exponential map, Haar measure) is Lie theory, not calculus.
calculus.source: 2026-10-14 calculus research (Wikipedia: Calculus; generalized Stokes theorem).

linear_algebra.dim_so20: n(n-1)/2 = 190 generators, derived from the R^T R = I constraint count.
linear_algebra.haar: QR of Gaussian matrix + diagonal-sign correction -> Haar-uniform SO(20), ~10.7k flops.
linear_algebra.CORRECTION: Johnson-Lindenstrauss with k=3 is VACUOUS — the guarantee does not hold for 20->3. Use SVD-optimal projection (Eckart-Young) or coordinate planes. (Corrects the earlier JL note.)
linear_algebra.stability: Homeostasis via Jacobian eigenvalue placement: Re(lambda) < 0 continuous, rho(A) < 1 discrete. Non-normal transient warning applies.

differential_geometry.manifolds: S^19 and SO(20) as Riemannian manifolds (round metric; bi-invariant <A,B> = -tr(AB)).
differential_geometry.interpolation: Geodesics are the paths: slerp with d = arccos(x0 . x1); d(R0,R1) = ||log(R0^T R1)||_F.
differential_geometry.rotation_engine: Exponential map exp_p(v) = gamma_v(1). Updates R <- R exp(eps A) cannot leave the manifold.
differential_geometry.projection_distortion: Curvature (Theorema Egregium) => 20->3 MUST distort. Quantified by SVD of the Jacobian: 17 tangent directions annihilated, pullback metric rank 3. Distortion is measured, not hidden.
differential_geometry.doll_nesting: Nested submanifolds / fiber bundles / foliations — the Russian doll made rigorous.
differential_geometry.tangent_layer: Tangent spaces are the per-node interaction layer; parallel transport compares vectors across positions.
differential_geometry.feasible: Everything named (exp, slerp, QR, SVD, transport) is ~1e4 flops at n=20 — browser-feasible. Curvature tensors and bundle formalism stay design language.
